about.title: About MatsuKaeru

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.p1: Service updates tell you what happened. MatsuKaeru goes one step further and suggests what to do.
purpose.p2: When service is suspended, it shows an estimate and an action to help you decide whether to wait or switch.

approach.title: How we estimate
approach.p1: We use knowledge from a former train dispatcher, generalized into signs anyone can observe.
approach.p2: We read signals from the notices you bring and estimate the current phase and a range for the time to resumption.
approach.p3: Numbers such as arrival times and the decision point are computed by code. The AI interprets and explains them.
approach.p4: When we are not confident, we focus on the decision point instead of a firm estimate.

notes.title: Notes
notes.p1: Everything shown is an estimate. Follow official announcements and station staff first.
notes.p2: We do not fetch railway service information automatically. Advice is based on what you enter.
notes.p3: Ride times and fares are approximate and may differ from actual ones.
notes.p4: Your location and input are used only to give advice and are never stored.

about.intro: MatsuKaeru blends the Japanese “matsu” (wait) and “norikaeru” (switch trains). Kaeru also means frog. It aims to shorten the time you spend not knowing what to do.
about.subtitle: Wait, or switch?

knowledge.notice: The knowledge generalizes the developer's hands-on experience into signals observable from outside. It contains no internal company information.
